items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Well Charlie Cedric was a cornet player and he specialized on rhythm... He played on the St. Paul of St. Louis.

ctx.x: I'd like to know more about the crap too.

Well Charlie Cedric was a cornet player and he specialized on rhythm. He really knew how to play the kind of music that the people wanted. He played on the St. Paul of St. Louis. He had, well the people, well the boat did a very nice business and was due to the fact that this fellow really put out, had the best music in town. He was a good boy and he handled his men in pretty good shape. Later years, he looked not pretty bad so he didn't play too much cornet, too much cornet, but he would always get a good cornet…
But would he play the blues on the boat and all?
